facts.fact: LocaleNLP says it has executive authorization from The Gambia's Minister of Communications for a pilot of Wolof and Mandinka speech and translation tools, aimed at integration into the National e-Government iPortal so citizens can use services by voice (vendor's claim only).
facts.system: LocaleNLP voice pilot for the National e-Government iPortal

GMB.note: Models are being tuned by a vendor, but the document does not say they are developed or hosted in The Gambia.
Names the National e-Government iPortal but states no service, count, sign-in or usage.
